summary: Code-index status and optional build/rebuild controls.

tools.notes: Optional read-only diagnostic of index freshness, dirtiness and graph availability. Queries prepare the index automatically and report their own freshness; no status or build call is needed first. verbose:true adds derived-evidence and artifact-path detail. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- code-index status --json`.
use_when: Inspect code index freshness, dirtiness or graph availability as an optional read-only diagnostic.
do_not_use_when: Before asking a code-index query; queries prepare the index automatically and need no status or build prerequisite.

recommended_first_call.operation: inspect the configured workspace code index status

tools.notes: Optional control that prepares the repo code index for a configured workspace repository now. Queries already prepare this ignored derived cache automatically, so no build call is needed first. A dirty worktree is reported, never refused. A cache path that is not git-ignored refuses with cache_path_not_ignored. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- code-index build --json --dir <repo>`.
use_when: Optional ahead-of-query preparation is explicitly wanted; every query already prepares the index automatically.
do_not_use_when: A code-index query is about to run; queries prepare the index automatically.

recommended_first_call.operation: prepare the configured workspace code index

tools.notes: Optional control that forces a clean rebuild of the repo code index for a configured workspace repository, re-extracting every committed source. Queries already prepare this ignored derived cache automatically. A dirty worktree is reported, never refused. A cache path that is not git-ignored refuses with cache_path_not_ignored. CLI fallback: `npm run wiki -- code-index rebuild --json --dir <repo>`.
use_when: A clean re-extraction of every committed source is explicitly wanted.
do_not_use_when: The index only needs to be current; queries refresh it automatically.

recommended_first_call.operation: force a clean rebuild of the configured workspace code index
